## Capstone Course

---

- HBIO 401L Physiology of Movement Units: 4

## Electives

---

Choose two courses from this list with a maximum of one course at the 200 level:

- HBIO 202Lg Nutrition for Life Units: 4
- HBIO 205Lgx The Science of Sport Units: 4
- HBIO 250g The Pharmacology of Performance-Enhancing Drugs Units: 4
- HBIO 301L Human Anatomy Units: 4
- HBIO 309 The Human Machine Units: 4
- HBIO 441L Prevention of Athletic Injuries Units: 4
- HBIO 442L Evaluation and Rehabilitation of Athletic Injuries Units: 4

## Minimum Units: 16

---

## Note:

---

A course used to satisfy the coaching requirement cannot be double counted to satisfy an elective requirement.
No more than 4 units of PHED “activity” courses may be applied to a student’s overall unit requirement; consult an adviser about course selection.

notes.text: The minor in Coaching, Health and Wellness provides students with a foundation in exercise science, athletic coaching and principles of health and wellness. This interdisciplinary program equips students with the knowledge and skills to promote performance, physical fitness, mental well-being and overall health in diverse settings. Whether students aspire to work with athletes, are fitness enthusiasts or seek to improve their wellness, this minor offers a framework for those passionate about fostering healthy lifestyles and peak performance.
